source: With it on, {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, auto-imports from subdirectories of {5}, handlers registered without a {6}, and server files with a dotted suffix in their names, such as {7}, all keep working. A handler that returns a string still sends it as {8} unless it sets a content type, and a handler that returns {9} still responds with {10}, or with the status it set.
